title: myosurus aristatus subsp. montanus
intro: Myosurus aristatus subsp. montanus, commonly known as Mountain Mouse Tail, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties, primarily used to treat various health conditions. The plant has been traditionally used for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, offering potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Mouse Tail include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions.
